sentences.text: Sánchez's announcement comes after a series of measures to tackle the housing crisis was defeated in parliament on Friday Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called an early election for 29 November after recent defeats on legislation aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Speculation about a snap election had been building over the weekend after parliament rejected two decree laws put forward by the minority government to protect tenants in the rental market.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home after she was unable to afford a sharp rent rise has sparked nationwide protests and increased pressure for housing reform.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: In a televised address on Monday, Sánchez said that to push reforms through he needed "a broader progressive majority" that can "overcome the resistance of the elites".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Housing has not been the only issue causing problems for Sánchez's leadership in recent months, with his party having been caught up in numerous corruption scandals and facing pressure on other cost-of-living issues and immigration.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: "We have made mistakes and have not achieved everything we had set out to do," Sánchez said, acknowledging there were still "a lot of problems to solve, particularly in the areas of inequality, of public services and access to housing".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Sánchez's left-wing coalition government is made up of his ruling Socialist party and junior partner the Sumar alliance, and does not have a majority in parliament.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Spain was not due to hold a general election until the summer of 2027 at the latest.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Sánchez has been prime minister since June 2018.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: His Socialist party finished second in the last election, in 2023.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Although the conservative People's Party won the most seats, it fell short of a majority.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Sánchez remained in power after striking agreements with left-wing parties and securing support from Catalan and Basque nationalist and pro-independence groups.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Most opinion polls suggest the conservatives are likely to emerge as the largest party in the next election.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: However, they would be expected to need the support of the hard-right Vox party to form a government.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Speaking after Monday's announcement, the leader of the People's Party, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, said: "At last, Spaniards will be able to decide".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The opposition leader said it would not be "just another election", but a chance for voters to choose between "decline or change, lies or change, incompetence or change, division or change, corruption or change".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from her Madrid home led to public outcry On Saturday, tens of thousands of people took to the streets in cities including Madrid, Valencia and Barcelona, calling for greater protections for tenants.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, became a symbol of Spain's housing crisis when she was forcibly evicted from her Madrid home on 23 September.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: A legal glitch allowed her landlord to raise her rent from €500 (£428; $572) to €2,650.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: It was later lowered to €1,650 - still €300 more than her monthly pension.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: She was removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years, and was later admitted to hospital.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Protests over housing took place in Madrid on Saturday Her lawyer has since said she will be able to return to her home , but the incident has prompted widespread anger over housing.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The left-wing coalition government responded with two decree laws in an effort to defuse the protests.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The first included the suspension of evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, a two-year extension to rental leases due to expire before 2028, tax increases for tourist apartments, and a restriction on the purchase of residential properties by what the government calls "vulture funds".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The second decree was more controversial, because it included the automatic renewal of rental contracts, a major demand of many on the left and the tenants' organisation Sindicato de Inquilinas.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The political right argued the government's attempt to intervene in the housing market would have led to fewer homes being rented and would have raised prices further.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Juan Bravo of the People's Party said last week "housing doesn't get cheaper with decrees, it gets cheaper with more homes".
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: Sánchez's leadership has been marred by numerous corruption scandals in recent months.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: In April, his wife Begoña Gómez was charged with corruption after a two-year criminal investigation.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: She is accused of using her relationship to advance her private career - allegations she denies, and which have been dismissed by Sánchez as a right-wing attempt to undermine his coalition.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: In May, police raided the Socialist party's headquarters in Madrid as part of an investigation into allegations an operative was paid to carry out a misinformation campaign.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The party has denied the allegations.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: And in June, Sánchez's former transport minister, José Luis Ábalos, was jailed for 24 years after he was found guilty of being involved in a network that received kickbacks from the sale of face masks during the Covid-19 pandemic.
sentences.article_title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests

sentences.text: The chair of Sánchez's Socialist Party (PSOE) Cristina Narbona and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez during a meeting earlier on Monday Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's decision to call a snap election for 29 November came on the back of a parliamentary defeat.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: On Friday, the raft of measures he had presented to congress aimed at improving conditions for tenants and trying to address the problem of soaring rentals was narrowly rejected, as parties on the right voted against them.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: That parliamentary result confirmed that Sánchez's left-wing coalition no longer commanded a majority.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: But as has so often been the case throughout Sánchez's career, the calling of the election was not a knee-jerk reaction but a carefully thought-out manouevre.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: His government has been struggling in recent months.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: His Socialist Party has been mired in corruption, with cases implicating former senior figures in the party, Santos Cerdán and José Luis Ábalos, while the former Socialist Prime Minister, José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero, is facing accusations of having benefited financially from the government's bailout of an airline.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Zapatero has denied wrongdoing.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: In addition, Sánchez's wife, Begoña Gómez, is due to go on trial over allegations of misuse of funds and influence peddling - accusations that Gómez and Sánchez vehemently deny.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Meanwhile, Sánchez's administration has struggled to manage the crisis in the Spanish exclave of Ceuta in North Africa, where more than 70,000 migrants suddenly arrived in July.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Most have returned over the border to Morocco, but the city has become a political and logistical headache for the prime minister.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Thousands have protested in cities across Spain against the government's handling of the influx of migrants to Ceuta Although Sánchez had insisted until recently that he would see out the legislature and not call elections until next summer, his government had looked increasingly unlikely to make it that far.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: The wave of outrage which has exploded in recent days over housing has provided him with the ideal reason to call elections early - and a welcome issue away from Ceuta and the allegations of corruption.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Appealing to his own party's voters and those further to the left on Monday, he called for voters to "mobilise and ensure that parliament gives us a much bigger, progressive majority with which to defeat the elites, conquer social rights and keep transforming Spain".
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: However, as a matter of policy, parties on the right tend to oppose the kind of direct intervention in the housing market that Sánchez has been advocating, warning that it can be counterproductive.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Earlier this year, when Sánchez's international profile rose due to his outspoken criticism of Israel's actions in Gaza and his clashes with US President Donald Trump, there was speculation that he might have used the political capital that gave him on the left and called an early election back then.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: However, the housing issue, which is the biggest concern for Spaniards according to polls, appears more likely to mobilise support on the left.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Yet polls also show that the Socialists are trailing the PP.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: While the housing issue provides Sánchez with a potential fillip on the campaign trail, staying in power after these elections will be probably the biggest challenge of his career.
sentences.article_title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election

sentences.text: Tobias Rausch easily won the vote with the backing of nine MPs beyond his own party A month after Germany's far-right AfD scored a decisive victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt, the party's candidate Tobias Rausch has been elected as parliament speaker there too.
sentences.article_title: AfD candidate elected speaker of German regional parliament for first time

sentences.text: Not since World War Two has a far-right party secured the post of speaker, and protesters outside the building in Magdeburg held up banners saying, "Never again is now".
sentences.article_title: AfD candidate elected speaker of German regional parliament for first time

sentences.text: Although the AfD fell three seats short of a majority in last month's election, Rausch, 35, comfortably won Tuesday's vote with the support of 9 MPs from other parties.
